description: The chart illustrates quality score results for three methods (IFD, Quali, and DEITA) using two metrics shown as paired bars per method, with additional dashed horizontal reference lines labeled as base averages. The horizontal axis contains the category labels “IFD,” “Quali,” and “DEITA” (left to right) and is labeled “Quality Scores,” while the vertical axis is labeled “Scores” and uses a linear scale spanning approximately 30 to 70 with regularly spaced tick marks at 5-point intervals. For each category, two adjacent bars are shown: a light blue bar labeled “Avg\_obj” and a light salmon bar labeled “Avg\_sub,” with numeric values printed above each bar. For IFD, the light blue Avg\_obj bar is about 63.98 and the light salmon Avg\_sub bar is about 41.90; for Quali, Avg\_obj is about 66.06 and Avg\_sub is about 39.13; for DEITA, Avg\_obj is about 67.64 and Avg\_sub is about 42.99. Two dashed horizontal lines provide baselines: a blue dashed line labeled “Base Avg\_obj” at approximately 64.71 and an orange dashed line labeled “Base Avg\_sub” at approximately 37.91. The bars are grouped by method (two bars per group) and are not shown as stacked; no additional visual emphasis beyond the value annotations and the baseline lines is present, and the category order appears fixed rather than explicitly sorted by value.
